executions.reason: the expected tools ran in order and the run recorded a terminal answer

registeredTools.description: Compare up to four currently rendered offers by item price, shipping, delivered price, availability, and merchant rating. Every returned offer carries an offer_ref for show_offer; unpriced_rows reports how many rendered rows of that store could not be priced.

limit.description: Number of lowest-delivered-price offers to return, from 1 to 4.

registeredTools.name: compare_page_offers

registeredTools.description: Return the product, current minimum price, rating, and offer count shown on this BestPrice item page.
registeredTools.name: get_page_product

registeredTools.description: Return structured specifications for the product on this BestPrice item page, optionally focused on one specification section or one fact. A shortened value is marked truncated; ask for that fact by name to read it in full.

fact.description: A fact name returned by a previous call. Returns that fact in full; pass its section too when the name appears in more than one section.

limit.description: Maximum number of specification facts to return, from 1 to 16.

section.description: Use all or a section name shown on this product, such as Οθόνη, Ισχύς, or Διαστάσεις.

registeredTools.name: get_product_specifications

registeredTools.description: Start a BestPrice product search and navigate this browser tab to the results.

query.description: Product, brand, model, or shopping need to search for.

registeredTools.name: search_bestprice

registeredTools.description: Scroll this BestPrice item page to one merchant offer it already shows and mark it for the shopper. Use the offer_ref returned by compare_page_offers; merchant_id or merchant_name also work when they identify exactly one shown offer. It never opens a merchant page and never exposes a merchant URL.

merchant_id.description: Numeric merchant id from compare_page_offers, when the page exposes one.

merchant_name.description: Merchant name exactly as compare_page_offers returned it.

offer_ref.description: Page-local offer reference from compare_page_offers. Exact, and the only selector that can separate two stores with the same displayed name. A reference names one quote: it is refused once the page state, the merchant, the variant or any price or shipping amount changes; read the offers again.

registeredTools.name: show_offer

registeredTools.description: Open or focus the price-history chart for the product currently shown on the BestPrice item page.
registeredTools.name: show_price_history

registeredTools.description: Return the current, lowest, and highest recorded prices plus recent and overall price direction for this BestPrice product.
registeredTools.name: summarize_price_history

result.product_title: Samsung Crystal UHD UE43U8072F Smart Τηλεόραση 43" 4K UHD LED HDR (2025) [UE43U8072FUXXH]

terminal.text:
Η τιμή της Samsung Crystal UHD UE43U8072F (43" 4K UHD LED HDR, 2025) κινήθηκε ως εξής σύμφωνα με το ιστορικό τιμών του BestPrice (222 καταγραφές, από 05/02/2026 έως 16/09/2026):

- Τρέχουσα ελάχιστη τιμή: 242,80 €
- Ιστορικό χαμηλό: 222,90 €
- Ιστορικό υψηλό: 264,48 €
- Μεταβολή από την πρώτη καταγραφή: −8% (πτωτική πορεία συνολικά)
- Πιο πρόσφατη μεταβολή: +1,2% (ελαφρά ανοδική), από τις 04/09/2026

Δηλαδή η τιμή έχει υποχωρήσει συνολικά από την αρχή της περιόδου, αλλά τις τελευταίες ημέρες κινείται ελαφρώς ανοδικά, με την τρέχουσα τιμή να βρίσκεται αρκετά πάνω από το ιστορικό χαμηλό.
